title: AimAgentScenarioProfile
description: Domain-neutral scenario profile. Carries only a generic target value, crosshair and calibration seeds, capability flags, and an authorized foreground identity. It never encodes game-specific semantics and is never a mandatory dependency of perception, tracking, or aiming.

schema_version.description: Contract version of this profile document. Bumped only by an approved migration.

profile_id.description: Stable identifier recorded in run manifests.

default_target_value.description: Uniform generic reward weight stamped onto every observation by enrich().

max_engagement_seconds.description: Wall-clock engagement window. 0 means the adapter imposes no cap.

capabilities.description: Every flag defaults to false. A consumer must treat an un-advertised capability as unavailable and use its own safe default.

foreground.description: Authorization configuration only. The host performs the OS foreground query; the adapter never enumerates processes and never inspects another process' memory.

process_name.description: Exact executable name. Empty means unspecified.

window_title_substring.description: Case-insensitive window-title substring. Empty means unspecified.

require_match.description: When true an unconfirmed identity fails closed.

calibration_seed.description: A starting hint for the online calibrator. Never replaces a measured calibration.

valid.description: When true every seed value must be strictly positive and in range.

crosshair.description: Screen-space crosshair seed handed to the aim policy.
